title: edit-scaffold input
description: One failure cluster plus the single change proposed against it. Exactly one target file and one change block: two changes in one replay cannot be attributed.

cluster.description: The cluster from analyze-failures this change targets. Quote its fields; do not re-cluster here.

target.description: The one file the change touches: a playbook, a skill's strategy file, a pattern, a threshold file, or a tool script.

change_kind.description: Inferred from the target path when omitted; naming contract, evaluator, spec or tolerance is refused.

change.description: The proposed text or diff. The new wording, not a description of it.

tightens_only.description: Required for a verifier check. A check that loosens needs a human, and the build plan allows tightening only.

same_change_already_rolled_back.description: True when the changelog records this exact change as rolled back; it is then refused rather than retried.

offline_replay_possible.description: True for diagnosis, retrieval and ranking changes, which can be screened against ledger history without device time.

screen_operators.description: The two or three cheap dev operators for stage-one screening.

playbook.description: Playbook name to default the target to, when the cluster's tags name one.
